Previously active Anibong, Buboy, and Sampaloc listings absent from category and sub-barangay pages — recorded as gone. Pila page: Bulilan Norte and Mojon persisting; Bulilan Sur entries excluded (structures or above 5 ha); Santa Clara Norte PHP 100,000/759 sqm entry likely data error — excluded; Phuket Mansions confirmed Silang, Cavite (out of scope); Pansol 70,090 sqm above 5 ha excluded. market_read: Week 8 snapshot: 13 verified rows (0 new, 13 persisting), 6 gone, 0 indicative — the largest single-week delisting count since tracking began. The six gone listings include three Pagsanjan-core parcels (Buboy 10,454 sqm at PHP 500/sqm, Anibong 13,708 sqm at PHP 547/sqm, Sampaloc 29,434 sqm at PHP 3,000/sqm) plus Calios Santa Cruz (PHP 450/sqm), Primera Parang Lumban (PHP 1,127/sqm), and Bucal Magdalena (PHP 1,200/sqm). Whether these are sales or listing expirations is unconfirmed; if real sales, the Buboy and Anibong delistings at PHP 500–547/sqm represent the first cleared Pagsanjan-core price signals in this dataset. Verified range PHP 269–2,800/sqm; overall dataset median PHP 1,500/sqm (7 of 13 rows). Pagsanjan-core (5 remaining rows) median PHP 1,100/sqm; ring (8 rows) median PHP 2,000/sqm. All 13 remaining rows carry unchanged asking prices. For a raw 0.5–1 ha Pagsanjan parcel, the tightest Pagsanjan-core comparables are Barangay I (PHP 700/sqm, persisting) and Maulawin (PHP 2,000/sqm, persisting); recommended asking range PHP 1,400–1,800/sqm; fastest-sale price PHP 1,000/sqm, revised down from prior PHP 1,400 to reflect the PHP 500–547/sqm clearance signals at Buboy and Anibong if those delistings are confirmed sales.
